businessProblem: FTX Trading Ltd. requires immediate diagnosis of root causes and a highest-priority action plan given an active customer-run with approximately $6 billion withdrawn in 72 hours, unverified customer asset segregation, abandoned Binance rescue deal, and uncertain ability to honor customer withdrawals as of 8 November 2022.

evidence.finding: Exchange facing customer withdrawal demand exceeding available liquid assets; approximately $6 billion in withdrawals in 72-hour crisis window
evidence.source: Exchange liquidity and customer withdrawal reporting

evidence.finding: Binance rescue deal publicly announced then abandoned; no concluded alternative rescue arrangement
Customer fund segregation from exchange and affiliated-party (Alameda Research) operations unverified and under serious question
evidence.source: Customer asset protection and governance risk analysis

evidence.finding: Controls over Alameda Research-FTX financial relationships inadequate; balance-sheet opacity creating correlated risk
Exchange operating under extreme crisis conditions; withdrawal processing under severe pressure
Confidence collapse across customers, counterparties, and market; no credible path to restore confidence without immediate independent asset verification
Governance and control structure wholly inadequate; regulatory engagement and customer protection obligations potentially unmet

clientContext.size: Major global cryptocurrency exchange with large retail and institutional customer base
clientContext.revenueImpactUrgency: Critical - active customer-run, rescue deal failed, customer asset segregation unverified
